note: RM-01.c hard extraction corpus. Cases deterministic Tier 0/1 CANNOT handle: implicit facts, facts buried in narrative, paraphrase multi-facts that do not split on '; '/ 'and also', coreference. Gold facts are the atomic propositions a capable LLM should emit; matching is cover (short stored text covering gold tokens), not exact — an LLM will paraphrase. Queries use implicit wording so the raw blob ranks worse than the atomic fact. No PII, no correction cues. Unique gold across writes so 02.b restatement does not collapse the A/B.
